name: Sika® Colma Cleaner
tagline: Solvent-based cleaning agent for substrates and tools
summary: Sika® Colma Cleaner is a grease-free solvent specially formulated for the pre-cleaning of bond faces and the cleaning of tools and equipment.
metaDescription: Sika® Colma Cleaner is a grease-free solvent specially formulated for the pre-cleaning of bond faces and the cleaning of tools and equipment.
usage: Sika® Colma Cleaner is designed for cleaning surfaces prior to bonding and for cleaning of tools and equipment such as light metals and alloys, steel and stainless steel.
packaging: 1 l can , 6 cans per box 20 l Pail

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Sika® Colma Cleaner has a shelf life of 24 months from the date of production, if it is stored in undamaged, original, sealed packaging, and if the storage conditions are met.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Sika® Colma Cleaner shall be stored in dry conditions, where it is protected from direct sunlight and at temperatures between +5 °C and +25 °C.

items.label: Ambient air temperature
items.text: +5 °C to +40 °C, min. 3 °C above dew point temperature
